title: Cross-cryptocurrency return predictability
publication: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control 163 (2024), 104863

verified_methodology.pdf_page_25: Rolling half-day (720-minute) adaptive-LASSO forecasts and equal-weight top-minus-bottom quintiles across 30 coins.
verified_methodology.pdf_pages_37_38: Futures analysis uses 10-minute rebalancing as the primary practical interval, reports a 5-minute robustness case, and warns that execution delay can erode high-frequency profits.
verified_methodology.pdf_page_64_table_xvi: Primary futures table uses quintiles, half-day and one-day windows, a 10-minute rebalance, and the paper's historical 4-bp taker cost assumption.
verified_methodology.pdf_page_88_table_ax: Five-minute rebalancing is an appendix robustness analysis, not a parameter search instruction.
verified_methodology.unresolved_in_source: The manuscript defines adaptive-LASSO weights but does not specify a sufficiently reproducible lambda-selection procedure for this platform.

research_boundary: This source contains no observation from the project's future 180-day point-in-time universe and does not authorize return-data acquisition or live trading.
